filePath.description:
The absolute file path of the file an instance of this type represents
in the context of {@Link FileExplorer}. It is also the absolute file path
in the FileSystem the {@Link FileExplorer} corresponds to

children.description:
The children contents of this Folder. This field is only significant if the
`isDir` field is True

isDir.description:
Whether the entity this instance of FileExplorerFileInfo
represents a file or a folder.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes

lastModified.description: Datetime of the last time this file/folder is modified

kind.description: The type of file: .txt, .csv, etc. (Folder if this represents a folder)

title:
A FileInfo represents a File/Folder (like metadata) in the context of {@Link FileExplorer}.
It holds essential information regarding a file/folder such as its children, url, and parent.
It does not, however, contain the files content.
name: FileExplorerFileInfo
